name: Queets River
blurb: The Olympic Peninsula's wildest rain-forest river — gravel bars, elk and very few people.

sections.notes: Rough road to the trailhead. Wood everywhere — scout. Olympic National Park requires an entrance pass for all visitors ($30 per private vehicle, valid 7 days; the park is cashless).
sections.mapPendingReason: Queets Trailhead: Final run (2026-10-25): The nearest NPS launch POI is 'Queets Campground' Boat Launch (OBJECTID 20692; 47.628058, -124.017520), 427 m from v1's Queets Trailhead point, so it is a different site. Promote only if North/the coding agent agrees to relabel the put-in as Queets Campground (label change not made here). Imagery pass (2026-10-25, not promoted): No managing-agency source confirming access was found, so it was not eligible for imagery placement. Queets relabel not approved.

sections.notes: Gravel bars and wood. Olympic National Park requires an entrance pass for all visitors ($30 per private vehicle, 7 days); whether Hartzell Creek is inside the park boundary is not confirmed.

putInAccess.sourceName: National Park Service, Olympic NP: Queets Area Brochure
putInAccess.note: NPS POI is in vegetation ~60 m from the main channel (~20 m from a side channel) (research/raw/batch3/streaters.png). Restrictions: winter storms can damage roads and boat launches (NPS); log-jam hazards (NPS); side-channel vs main channel
putInAccess.directions: Queets River Rd to the NPS Streator Crossing launch; the main channel is ~60 m beyond the POI across a gravel bar (a side channel is closer).

takeOutAccess.sourceName: National Park Service, Olympic NP: Queets Area Brochure
takeOutAccess.note: NPS POI sits ~35-45 m inland of the gravel bar in forest, not at the water (research/raw/batch3/hartzell.png). Restrictions: winter storms can damage roads and boat launches (NPS); log-jam hazards (NPS); low water late summer
takeOutAccess.directions: Queets River Rd (off US 101) to the NPS Hartzell boat launch; carry across the gravel bar to the Queets.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
